# Outreach emails — wave 1 (fixture)

Cold outreach to six companies. CV versions: **A** = Cloud & GenAI, **B** = Full-stack.

- `[phone]` in the signature is a placeholder: fill it in before sending.
- Addresses marked **unverified** came from LinkedIn data via Exa — check the website before sending.

- **Send via:** hr@kookaburra.example · **Contact:** Dana Cole — CTO (LinkedIn); Lee Ross — Founder & CEO
- **Role:** Proposed: Part-time Junior Software Engineer (Node/AWS/AI), 16–20 h/week · **CV version:** A
- **Subject:** Part-time junior engineer (Node/AWS/AI), Jan–Jun 2027

>
> Your careers FAQ says part-time people should still apply, so I'm proposing a part-time role.
>
